sliders.notes: Tabler `adjustments` shows vertical sliders/equalizer controls. Matches the sliders/adjustments concept well.

theme.notes: Tabler `palette` represents colors/appearance. Good match for theme/colors.

light-mode.notes: Tabler `sun` is the standard light mode icon.

dark-mode.notes: Tabler `moon` is the standard dark mode icon.

plugin.notes: Tabler `puzzle` represents extensions/add-ons. Tagged with extension, add-on.

globe.notes: Tabler has both `globe` and `world`. `world` is more commonly used and shows a full globe with latitude/longitude lines.

cpu.notes: Tabler has `cpu` in the Devices category. Direct match.

storage.notes: Tabler has no dedicated hard-drive icon. `server` is the closest match for storage/disk concept. Considered `database` but that is more data-specific.

usb.notes: Tabler has `usb`. Direct match. Also has `device-usb` but `usb` is simpler.

cast.notes: Tabler has `cast`. Direct match for Chromecast/Airplay streaming.

terminal.notes: Tabler has `terminal`. Direct match. Tagged with console, command, git, command line.

server.notes: Tabler has `server` and `server-2`. Using `server-2` to differentiate from `storage` mapping above which uses `server`.

git.notes: Tabler has `git-branch` for version control branching. Good match for git/branch concept.

network.notes: Tabler has `network` in the Computers category. Direct match.

qr-code.notes: Tabler uses `qrcode` (no hyphen). Note the naming difference from Semantic UI `qr-code`.

barcode.notes: Tabler has `barcode` in the System category. Direct match.

random.notes: Tabler has `dice`. Good match for random/chance concept.

rain.notes: Tabler has `cloud-rain` in the Weather category. Good match.

storm.notes: Tabler has `storm` (code f24c) in the Weather category. Tagged with weather, cloud, lightning, rain, wind, tornado.

wind.notes: Tabler has `wind` in the Weather category. Direct match.

temperature.notes: Tabler has `temperature` in the Weather category. Direct match.

water.notes: Tabler has `droplet` in the Design category. Good match for water/humidity.

coffee.notes: Tabler has `coffee` in the Food category. Direct match.

eco.notes: Tabler has `leaf`. Good match for eco/nature concept.

hexagon.notes: Tabler has `hexagon` in the Shapes category. Direct match.

triangle.notes: Tabler has `triangle` in the Shapes category. Direct match.

google.notes: Tabler has `brand-google`. Brand icons use the `brand-` prefix.

twitter.notes: Tabler has both `brand-twitter` (old bird logo) and `brand-x` (current X logo, added v2.29). Using `brand-x` as it reflects the current branding.

microsoft.notes: Tabler has `brand-windows`. Best match for Microsoft/Windows.

sparkles.notes: Tabler has `sparkles`. Direct match for AI/magic concept.

wand.notes: Tabler has `wand` (added v1.5). Direct match for magic wand/auto-fix.

bot.notes: Tabler uses `robot` (not `bot`). Same concept for robot/automation.

email.notes: Tabler uses `mail` (not `email`). Direct match for envelope/email.

contacts.notes: Tabler has `address-book` (added v1.55). Good match for contacts/address book.

unlock.notes: Tabler uses `lock-open` (not `unlock`). Shows an open padlock.

security.notes: Tabler has `shield` in the System category. Tagged with safety, protect, protection.

secure.notes: Tabler has `shield-check`. Shield with checkmark for verified/secure.
